audit-log-sql.statement: INSERT INTO esq_auth_log (aul_action, aul_usr_pk, aul_connect_flg, aul_login_id, aul_email, aul_tfa_method, aul_force_change_flg, aul_security_question, aul_security_answer, aul_crl_id, aul_req_id, aul_uid, aul_action_ts) VALUES (:action, CAST(:entityId AS bigint), :connectFlg, :loginId, :email, :tfaMethod, :forceChangeFlg, :securityQuestion, :securityAnswer, :crl, :req, :uid, :actionTs) ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING
